failure_mode: Size-on-losses: the variant doubled position size after losing days, turning a -3% drawdown into a -11% halt.
pattern: Bound position size to pre-trade risk fraction; never condition size on recent PnL direction.

failure_mode: In-sample Sharpe 2.1 decayed to 0.2 out-of-sample; no cost model was stated.
pattern: Require forward-only splits, stated costs, and a full-cycle out-of-sample window before recording any result as evidence.

failure_mode: Model calibrated in low-vol regimes failed in high-vol months; metrics were never sliced by regime.
pattern: Slice every calibration metric by regime; blindness to the breaking regime is the ordinary failure.

failure_mode: Reported win-rate excluded cancelled signals; censoring was silent, inflating accuracy by 9 points.
pattern: Track censoring explicitly (resolution rate, censor rate, censoring by regime); censored is a third class, never a win.

failure_mode: Publication timestamps used as event timestamps leaked future information into features.
pattern: Every feature carries source-published observed_at_ns; R12 drops anything observed after the snapshot.

failure_mode: Episodic memory of past trades leaked outcomes into the model's context (oracle fallacy).
pattern: Replay uses logged feature rows, never agent re-runs; agent memory never enters the decision path.

failure_mode: Three independent deployments traded the same signal; aggregate fill volume erased the edge within weeks.
pattern: Assume crowding and alpha decay; size caps and exposure limits bound the damage when edge fades.

failure_mode: Backtest ignored spreads and fees; live returns were negative after costs on the same rules.
pattern: Evaluate net of all costs including AI spend share; gross results are not reported or considered.

failure_mode: Uncapped retry loop on a failing tool spent $400 in one night with no position to show for it.
pattern: Hard per-cycle caps on calls, tools, tokens, and wall time; aborted cycles publish nothing and never retry in-interval.

failure_mode: Overconfident probability outputs were used as entry thresholds directly; 70% forecasts realized at 41%.
pattern: Bands and consensus over raw probabilities; conviction nominates, the deterministic engine authorizes.

failure_mode: A frozen vendor feed replayed identical values for hours while the system treated them as fresh.
pattern: Frozen-feed detection: identical payloads across FROZEN_N polls spanning half the nominal cover mark the source stale.

failure_mode: Cherry-picked window start/end turned a flat strategy into a published Sharpe of 1.4.
pattern: Forward-only walk-forward discipline with untouched holdout; window cherry-picking voids the run.
